text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Flash floods which hit Zimbabwe's northern districts earlier this month left a trail of destruction and thousands of dollars will be needed to carry out repairs, while villagers whose homes were destroyed by the deluge are now desperate for shelter.
- President Mugabe arrived in the Botswana capital, Gaborone for a two-day Commonwealth retreat on democracy and good governance on the African continent.
- Police will immediately institute investigations into sodomy allegations against former president Canaan Banana, Police Commissioner Augustine Chihuri said.
